title: seam(objectui console): render the environment's trigger-binding audit as a health item in environment detail — the visible half of cloud#1962's control-plane-clock ADR (route-B ruling on cloud#1288, 2026-08-15)
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#1962

Seam card filed by the `repo:cloud` PM seat (objectstack#6026, session `session_01EK4Q5Nrx779cxjdeTxsK7P`) — 2026-09-04T03:2xZ. **Named reader: the objectui execution seat (`domain:ui`), at candidate selection — ⛔ not before its blocker closes.**

## Why this card exists

On cloud#1288 (2026-08-15, `os-zhuang`, delegated adjudication) the maintainer ruled route B — the control plane owns the clock for hosted scheduled automation — and instructed:

> Fold in the parked scope-3 item — surfacing `getTriggerBindingAudit()` as an environment-level health item — since it needs the same console surface; that is two cards, cloud's being the `Blocked-by:` of objectui's.

cloud#1962 is the cloud card (the ADR + the read-only exposure). This is the objectui card.

## What it renders

The framework already produces the data: `AutomationEngine.getTriggerBindingAudit()` / `getFlowRuntimeStates()`, emitted today only as WARN lines at `kernel:bootstrapped` (per flow: `flowName`, `triggerType`, `reason`). cloud#1962 exposes them read-only as an environment-level health item. This card renders that item in the environment detail view so a user sees "this automation is not bound / not scheduled, and why" **without an AI turn** — the distinction cloud#1316's dev drew: letting `verify_build` see a binding failure is in-turn; letting the user see it is a console surface, and that is what cloud#1288 asked for.

## ⛔ Sequencing

- Blocked on **cloud#1962**, which is itself blocked on **cloud PR #1926** (ADR-0112). ADR-0112 places scheduled/time-relative flows outside v1 of the hosted AI build, so this surface is post-v1 work. ⛔ Do not dispatch ahead of the chain.
- The data shape this renders is cloud's to declare (in #1962's read-only route); ⛔ do not invent it on the consumer side.

## Re-check

cloud#1288 (ruling comment 2026-08-15; unlock re-grade 2026-09-04) · cloud#1962 (the ADR card, its `Blocked-by:` and the health-item shape once drafted) · framework `AutomationEngine.getTriggerBindingAudit()`.
